experience.title: Building systems that real operations depend on.

roles.summary: Lead full-stack engineer on enterprise-grade operational and healthcare platforms. Own architecture, data modeling, realtime infrastructure and design systems across multiple products.
highlights: Designed multi-tenant architecture with RBAC, audit logging and granular policy enforcement.
Built realtime WebSocket layer powering live dashboards, presence and operational telemetry.
Migrated monolithic flows to a NestJS service architecture backed by PostgreSQL and Prisma.
Standardized a typed design system (shadcn/ui + Tailwind tokens) reused across 3 products.

roles.company: IMSS — Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social
roles.summary: Contributed to internal healthcare and operational systems used across public health facilities. Focused on reliability, data integrity and clinician-facing tooling.
highlights: Implemented patient workflow modules with strict validation and audit trails.
Optimized data ingestion pipelines, reducing batch processing windows significantly.
Collaborated with clinical staff to translate operational pain into product requirements.
Hardened legacy modules with type-safe contracts and automated testing.

roles.summary: Designed and shipped the in-house service management platform handling work orders, technicians, inventory and customer communications for an automotive multi-brand service center.
highlights: Built the service order lifecycle: intake, diagnosis, parts, labor, invoicing and delivery.
Integrated inventory and parts catalog with realtime stock movements.
Implemented role-scoped dashboards for advisors, technicians and management.
Reduced order processing time by replacing manual paperwork with an end-to-end digital flow.

projects.title: Projects engineered for operations.
projects.description: Three production systems that show how I think about architecture, realtime flows, RBAC, audit and the day-to-day reliability that operations teams actually need.

projects.name: MediFlow
projects.description: Clinical operations platform for medical practices: patient records, appointments, prescriptions, and provider workflows — built for compliance, auditability and clinician speed.
architecture: NestJS modular monolith with bounded contexts per clinical domain
PostgreSQL with Prisma; row-level policies enforce tenant + role scope
WebSocket gateway for live appointment + record updates
Background workers for reminders, exports and integration jobs
challenges: Designing an audit trail that's both clinician-readable and immutable.
Schema evolution without downtime on multi-tenant data.
Latency budget: keep critical screens under 100ms p95.

projects.name: Centro de Servicio Multimarcas
projects.description: End-to-end service order platform for a multi-brand automotive center. Handles intake, diagnosis, parts, labor, technicians, customers and invoicing in one operational system.
architecture: Next.js App Router with server components for heavy ops views
State machine modeling order transitions and side-effects
Postgres with strict referential integrity on parts movements
challenges: Modeling messy real-world service flows without locking the business in.
Inventory accuracy under concurrent technician updates.

projects.name: Enterprise POS & Inventory
projects.description: Operational POS and inventory system designed for multi-location businesses. Realtime stock movements, role-scoped registers, refunds, returns and end-of-day reconciliation built in.
architecture: NestJS services behind an API gateway with per-location scoping
Event-driven inventory updates over WebSocket + persisted log
Offline-tolerant register flow with reconciliation on reconnect
challenges: Reconciling local register state with the central source of truth.
Performance budget on low-end terminal hardware.

principles.title: How I approach the work.
principles.description: The values that shape how I scope, design and ship software — distilled from years of shipping production systems with real users behind them.

principles.title: Scalable architecture
principles.body: Design for the boundary, not the function. Clear domains, typed contracts and infrastructure that scales horizontally before it has to.

principles.title: Realtime systems
principles.body: WebSockets, presence, eventual consistency and reconciliation flows. The system should feel alive without becoming unpredictable.

principles.title: Security by default
principles.body: Authn/authz at the edge, RBAC enforced at the service, encryption at rest and audit trails wired in from day one — not bolted on.

principles.title: Maintainability
principles.body: Code that the next engineer can actually own. Strong types, small modules, deliberate abstractions and tests that capture behavior, not implementation.

principles.title: Performance budget
principles.body: Treat latency as a feature. Measure p95, optimize hot paths, cache deliberately and ship boring infrastructure before clever solutions.

principles.title: Premium UX
principles.body: Operational software deserves great UX. Information density, keyboard ergonomics, accessibility and motion that earns its place.

principles.title: Product engineering
principles.body: Talk to the people who actually use the system. Ship the thing that removes their friction — not the thing that's interesting to build.
